Gateway to the wondrous Basilica, the Grand Court overlooks the reflecting pool that gives [[the Mirror of Lyss]] its name. From here, one may ascend to the floating [[Sebelkeh Basilica]] itself, the most ornate and magical temple in [[Elona]], and the heart of the [[Lyssa]]n faith.

The '''Grand Court of Sebelkeh''' is the entrance to the renowned central place of worship to [[Lyssa]] in all of [[Vabbi]].

== Getting there ==
The [[primary quest]] [[Warning Kehanni]] concludes here. That quest only comes a while after your initial arrival in [[the Mirror of Lyss]]. This outpost can be located earlier by going north and around the large central lake.

== Exits ==

== Notes ==
{{gw2w|Grand Court of Sebelkeh}}
* The [[world map]] actually marks this location with the icon for an outpost upon initial arrival. It changes into the icon for a mission outpost only upon completion of the quest that precedes the [[Grand Court of Sebelkeh|Grand Court of Sebelkeh mission]], which is [[Pledge of the Merchant Princes]].
* On the raised platform are two glowing circles with signposts that resemble floor portals. They seem to hint that they can teleport characters into the [[Sebelkeh Basilica]] but in actuality, they are nothing but decorations.
* Grand Court of Sebelkeh, [[Tihark Orchard (outpost)|Tihark Orchard]], [[The Mouth of Torment]], [[Yahnur Market]], [[Brauer Academy]], [[Piken Square (pre-Searing)]], [[Sifhalla]], and [[Tarnished Haven]] are the only outposts with two exits leading to the same zone.
{{Anomaly| The quest marker will always point out of the east exit, even if heading out the west exit would be nearer to the next quest trigger.}}
